description: Provenance of every production asset used by the app (Issue #13). tests/studio-provenance.test.ts checks this file against the repository; any changed or new asset must be recorded here before it can be merged.

assets.creator: Shark Tank AI project contributors (original work)
assets.source: Generated by scripts/create-studio-avatar.mjs from the rig contract in src/features/studio/rig.ts. Geometry, skinning, materials and animation clips are all built in code; no model, texture, scan, likeness or animation was downloaded or purchased.
assets.license: No public licence has been applied to the project's original work. Choosing one is a group decision that is still open (see docs/design/asset-provenance.md).
assets.version: investor-v1, regenerated in Issue #30 (shared body, three feature meshes, 15 bones, 10 clips)
assets.modifications: Not derived from any third-party asset. Changes since Phase 4A: production characters (#5-#7), facial bones and gestures (#9), reactions (#10), merged feature slots (#12), policy-specific withdrawal clips (#30).
assets.redistribution: Original work created for this project; it may be redistributed together with the repository. Wider reuse depends on the group's licence decision. Public deployment stays prohibited while SE-001 is open.
tools: three 0.187.0 (MIT) GLTFExporter, used only to write the file; no three.js code is embedded in it
assets.evidence: Generator source is in the repository and reproduces the file; the file has no external buffers, images or extensions (checked by tests/studio-provenance.test.ts).
